name: easycaptionkit
description: easycaptionkit: burn captions into a video in the product's own fonts and colors, clear of each app's buttons, with SRT, VTT and ASS files.

plugins.name: easycaptionkit
plugins.description: Burns captions into a video from words with times (a speech-to-text JSON from OpenAI, whisper.cpp, WhisperX, ElevenLabs, Deepgram and others, an SRT or VTT file, or a demo's steps), word by word or line by line, in the site's own fonts and colors, kept clear of the buttons of TikTok, Reels, Shorts, YouTube, X and LinkedIn, and writes captions.srt, captions.vtt and captions.ass to go with it.
